description_id: Solusi penyimpanan cloud pribadi self-hosted premium dengan privasi penuh. Kelola dan sinkronisasi file Anda di perangkat Anda sendiri.
description_en: A premium self-hosted cloud storage solution designed for full privacy and control over your digital life.

description_id: IDE modern dengan performa tinggi, desain aesthetic, dan kecerdasan AI. Dibangun dengan Flutter untuk pengalaman coding yang mulus.
description_en: The next-gen aesthetic and high-performance IDE built with Flutter. Combining beautiful Material 3 design with AI intelligence.

description_id: Sistem manajemen perpustakaan berbasis C# WinForms dengan LINQ to SQL dan SQL Server. Kelola buku, anggota, kategori, dan peminjaman.
description_en: A library management system built with C# WinForms, LINQ to SQL, and SQL Server. Manage books, members, categories, and borrowing.

description_id: Aplikasi desktop ringan untuk mengekstrak palet warna dari gambar dan mengambil warna dari layar. Cocok untuk desainer dan developer.
description_en: A lightweight desktop app to extract color palettes from images and pick colors from screen. Perfect for designers and developers.

description_id: Sistem manajemen inventori spare part warehouse dengan tracking real-time, transaksi otomatis, dan role-based access control.
description_en: A spare part warehouse inventory management system with real-time tracking, automated transactions, and role-based access control.

description_id: Sistem manajemen transaksi dan layanan laundry berbasis desktop dengan tracking status real-time dan manajemen karyawan.
description_en: A desktop-based laundry management system with real-time transaction tracking and employee management.

description_id: Aplikasi e-commerce desktop dengan sistem keranjang belanja, multi-metode pembayaran, dan role-based access control untuk admin dan pelanggan.
description_en: A desktop e-commerce application with shopping cart system, multi-payment methods, and role-based access control for admin and customers.
